summary: Chinese novel attributed mainly to Cao Xueqin, about the rise and fall of a large noble family. It circulated in handwritten copies from the 1760s and was first printed in 1791. It is counted among China's four great classical novels.
aliases: The Dream of the Red Chamber

events.note: First printed in 1791; a revised printing followed in 1792. Handwritten copies circulated from the 1760s.
